description: A smartphone lies on a green sheet near a white charging cable, with a large white board leaning in the background. The right hand moves in to hold the phone while the left hand grips the cable connector and pulls it out of the phone, turning the phone into a right-hand object and the cable into a left-hand object; the left hand then releases the unplugged cable and points toward the leaning board while the right hand sets the phone back down.
